passive.name: Gokadaiou Otogibanashi
passive.text: DEF is increased by **28/35/42/49/56%**. Normal and Charged Attack DMG is increased by **40/50/60/70/80%** of DEF.

passive.name: Desert Watch
passive.text: After the character's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, their ATK will be increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for 8s. After the character takes DMG, their ATK will be increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for 8s. The 2 aforementioned effects can be triggered even when the character is not on the field. Additionally, when not protected by a shield, the character's Max HP will be increased by **32/40/48/56/64%**.

passive.name: Sunset Reignites the Dawn
passive.text:
Gain the "Scorching Brilliance" effect when using an Elemental Skill or Burst: CRIT DMG increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** and ATK increased by **28/35/42/49/56%** for 6s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
While a "Scorching Brilliance" instance is active, its duration is increased by 2s after Normal or Charged attacks deal Elemental DMG. This effect can trigger once every second, and the max duration increase is 6s.
Additionally, when the equipping character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, "Scorching Brilliance" effects are increased by 75%, and its duration will not count down when the equipping character is off-field.

passive.name: Wolfish Tracker
passive.text: Increases ATK by **20/25/30/35/40%**. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by **40/50/60/70/80%** for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.

passive.name: Wavesplitter
passive.text: Every 4s a character is on the field, they will deal **6/7/8/9/10%** more DMG and take **3/2.7/2.4/2.2/2%** more DMG. This effect has a maximum of 5 stacks and will not be reset if the character leaves the field, but will be reduced by 1 stack when the character takes DMG.

passive.name: Bane of Storm and Tide
passive.text: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Electro by **20/24/28/32/36%**.

substatLine: CRIT DMG > CRIT Rate > Elemental Mastery > Energy Recharge > ATK%
skillPriority: Elemental Skill > Normal Attack > Elemental Burst

entries.name: Tempered Sword
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Searing Onslaught
entries.text:
Performs a forward slash that deals **Pyro DMG**.

This skill can be consecutively used 3 times.
Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.

The slashes represent the values that Diluc holds dear: one for justice, one for courage, and one for duty.

entries.name: Dawn
entries.text:
Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing **Pyro DMG**. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive **Pyro DMG** to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of **AoE Pyro DMG**.
The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with **Pyro**.

The only reason to walk in the darkness is to light it up. Behold, that fleeing light in the dead of night is the herald of the coming dawn.

entries.name: Relentless
entries.text: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.

entries.name: Blessing of Phoenix
entries.text: The **Pyro Infusion** provided by **Dawn** lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% **Pyro DMG Bonus** during the duration of this effect.

entries.name: Tradition of the Dawn Knight
entries.text: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore-type weapons.

entries.name: Conviction
entries.text: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.

entries.name: Searing Ember
entries.text:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.

entries.name: Fire and Steel
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Searing Onslaught** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Flowing Flame
entries.text:
Casting **Searing Onslaught** in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting **Searing Onslaught**, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.

entries.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Dawn** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
entries.text:
After casting **Searing Onslaught**, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.
